verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships its own in-app AI features that work on the user's repository data. It suggests commit messages generated from staged diffs, and its Repository Agent is a conversational assistant that can browse, search and read repository files. Neither is documented as producing analytical insights about the data; the suggestions are limited to commit messages. Missing for 10: documented insight or analysis output beyond commit-message suggestions, details on Repository Agent's analytical capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence. These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI
Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
